newsitem.title: USA: Interphase names chief operating officer.
newsitem.headline: Interphase names chief operating officer.

text.p: Interphase Corp said Monday it has appointed Malcolm Cowan to the newly created post of chief operating officer.

Cowan will assume responsibility for all operational activities of the company, with direct accountability for all functional areas that relate to sales, marketing, engineering, and the implementation of systems, practices, measurements and controls to achieve maximum operational effectiveness, the company said.
Before joining Interphase, he served as general manager of Northern Telecom Ltd's North American PCS business unit in Mississauga, Ontario, and Dallas.
Interphase is an international supplier of connectivity solutions for computer networking environments.
